transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with today's access-coordination meeting. Before I publish tomorrow's access and staging plan, I need to hear from each of you on any changes affecting your work parties. We've got three support activities scheduled: a communications-calibration team, a water-treatment contractor, and a generator-inspection vehicle. Security, facilities, motor pool — please report any updates or issues that might affect entry through East or North Gate, or staging on pads A, B, or C.

I received the confirmed badge roster from the visitor-control desk this morning, but it hasn't been added to the access brief yet. This means the comms-calibration team must enter through East Gate within that one-hour window, or they won't be able to get on the installation.

transcript.text: I have a critical update for the water-treatment contractor. I confirmed with the utilities supervisor today that the scheduled electrical lockout at the plant won't be released until exactly 1130 tomorrow. The contractor cannot enter the plant until after that time, and they'll need the reserved work period following the release. However, our facilities schedule still shows the ordinary morning access window for this contractor, which is incorrect. The access plan needs to reflect entry no earlier than 1130, not the morning window currently listed.
